name: reboot-residue R-001 live: agenticmail.service stable, API entry under the exec'd node's global root, configured health 200
summary: Live probe of AUTO-BAR-R-001-P-001@5 on the dev box: agenticmail.service active/running with NRestarts 0->0 and the same MainPID across a 60s window; the exec line of the unit's start-server.sh names /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/lib/node_modules/agenticmail/node_modules/@agenticmail/api/dist/index.js, which exists and lies under `npm root -g` for that node's bin directory; the live process argv equals the exec line; the configured API (config.json api 127.0.0.1:3150) health route answers HTTP 200 {status:ok, api:ok, stalwart:ok}.
scope: Live host plane, read-only observation. Does not reinstall or restart anything. The clause's '/api/health' wording is resolved to the route the server actually mounts: the dist mounts its health router under /api/agenticmail (app.use("/api/agenticmail", createHealthRoutes(...))) and prints http://<host>:<port>/api/agenticmail/health as its own Health banner; a bare /api/health is not a served route and returns 404 (recorded, disclosed below).
oracle: Independent of the repair: systemd unit properties, the unit's own exec script, the exec'd node's npm root -g, /proc/<MainPID>/cmdline and an HTTP status code. No papercusp code or claim is consulted.
redaction: The operator's home directory is rendered as ~ in the retained log.

assertions.evidence: T0 and T1: LoadState=loaded ActiveState=active SubState=running; dev:service_health independently reported agenticmail.service active, failed:false, nRestarts 0 at 07:02Z.
NRestarts 0 -> 0 and MainPID 3758554 unchanged between 07:06:51Z and 07:07:51Z (an earlier independent 60s window 07:02:28Z-07:03:28Z also read 0 -> 0).
The file named on start-server.sh's exec line exists (sha256 770632bd...).
npm root -g run with the exec'd node's bin dir first on PATH reports /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/lib/node_modules; the entry path has that prefix.
GET http://127.0.0.1:3150/api/agenticmail/health -> 200 {"status":"ok","version":"0.5.62","services":{"api":"ok","stalwart":"ok"}}. Host and port read from ~/.agenticmail/config.json api block.
Disclosure, not a failure: GET /api/health on the same host:port returns 404 because the server never mounts that path; the served health route is /api/agenticmail/health.
